traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are implemented and verified: - File-level @supports annotations for test files are enforced, with safe auto-fix inserting a placeholder template when missing. - describe() blocks in test files must include a story reference matching a configurable pattern (defaulting to the "Story XXX.X-..." format), and violations are reported with clear messages. - it()/test() names in test files must start with a `[REQ-...]` requirement ID; missing or malformed prefixes are reported, and common formatting errors are auto-fixed without inventing new IDs. - Test file detection uses configurable path-substring patterns to restrict enforcement to test files only. - The rule supports common test frameworks (Jest, Mocha) by recognizing `describe`, `it`, `test`, and `context`, and works with Jest’s member-call variants like `describe.each`. - The rule is fully wired into the plugin’s dynamic loading and flat-config presets, and its presence and severity are verified by dedicated tests. - User documentation describes the rule, its options, and its expected usage, and an example test file illustrates the conventions. Given the implemented rule code, helper functions, comprehensive tests tied explicitly to this story, successful Jest run, and documented behavior, this story is assessed as fully implemented.
